{{Top}}
{{Quote|Even after the state revokes the licenses of medical criminals, some hard cases still practice illegally, and they need suppliers. A slythmonger sells illegal prescription drugs for these disbarred medics.|[[Hal Horn]]|<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Hal Horn|Corellia}}</ref>}}
A '''slythmonger''' was a dealer or peddler in [[Spice/Legends|drugs]] who trafficked wares for disbarred pharmacists. They could specialize in [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] as [[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] did, or distribute a wide variety of illegal and highly narcotic and/or deadly substances. Most had no real idea of the ingredients they were moving, and were addicted to their employer's wares.
